page_title: RMA 1-1 ATM | Real Madrid v Atletico Madrid 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Jose Sanchez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+3' 1 - 1 Goal! Nice headed pass by Memphis Depay to Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid), who latches on to it and puts the ball into the back of the net with a fine header. 1:1.
90+1' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.
89' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Andriy Lunin easily deals with the threat.
88' Substitution. Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) replaces Jude Bellingham.
88' Real Madrid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
85' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.
84' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
81' The attendance for today's match is 76732.
79' The resulting corner from Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
79' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
76' The substitution is prepared. Luka Modric (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrygo.
72' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
71' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Joselu (Real Madrid) replaces Brahim Diaz.

70' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
68' That will be all from Koke who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
67' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
67' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Now Atl. Madrid have a corner.

66' Jan Oblak was forced into action to thwart Rodrygo (Real Madrid). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
66' PENALTY APPEAL after Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
62' The ball is cleared after Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
61' The referee allows time for a substitution. Rodrigo de Paul will be replaced by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid).
61' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) replacing Saul Niguez.
61' Here comes a substitution. Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Alvaro Morata.
60' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
60' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jan Oblak comes off the line to clear the ball away.
56' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
54' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) receives a lofted cross on the edge of the box and sends a shot to the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no trouble saving this one.
53' Real Madrid enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
50' The Atl. Madrid players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Jose Sanchez signals NO GOAL following the VAR review.
50' The Atl. Madrid players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
48' Goal! The corner is whipped in and Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the left side of the goal. He makes it 1:1.
48' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

48' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
46' Diego Simeone makes a half-time substitution. Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) comes on in place of Rodrigo Riquelme.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+1' Good team movement sets up Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atl. Madrid.

39' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) launches himself at the ball from the free kick and produces a header which lacks accuracy, sending it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
39' It seemed like Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
38' It must be a yellow card. It is. Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

36' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
36' A quickly taken corner by Atl. Madrid.
35' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
34' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
32' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.

30' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
29' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
27' Chance! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
24' The corner is flicked onto Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
24' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) steps up to send the ball in.

23' Andriy Lunin makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) after a cross from the side. The ball goes out for a corner. Atl. Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
23' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
23' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.
20' 1 - 0 Goal! Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:0.
19' Good movement by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
19' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
18' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Atl. Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
16' Andriy Lunin leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
15' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
12' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
10' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
8' A pass into the box finds Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Andriy Lunin denies him.

5' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
4' Great save! Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Jan Oblak.
3' Real Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

3' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
Jose Sanchez will supervise the game today.
